title: Slurm Power Save：休眠損益與喚醒延遲
titleEn: Slurm power saving: sleep break-even and wake latency
subcategoryTitle: 排程與可重現軟體堆疊
summary: 以合成資料重建「Slurm Power Save：休眠損益與喚醒延遲」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付能源分解、損益點、喚醒狀態機與預留時間表。
summaryEn: Reconstruct Slurm power saving: sleep break-even and wake latency with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver energy breakdowns, break-even point, wake-state machines and reservation timing.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

quiz.question: 「能源邊界圖」：哪一項是需要由具名官方來源查證的案例背景，而非本課的故障假說或處置判斷？
quiz.questionEn: Energy-boundary diagram: Which is case context to establish from the named official source, rather than a fault hypothesis or disposition?
options: 若節能卻增加工作遲到，查 resume timeout、啟動抖動與預留；失聯節點不能被視為已可排程。
同時通過能量與準時喚醒才接受；不要在本課操作真實機房電源。
Slurm 可透過 suspend/resume 管理空閒節點；本課以能源帳本分析休眠何時值得。
optionsEn: Energy savings with late jobs require checking resume timeout, boot variability and reservations; unresponsive nodes are not schedulable.
Accept only when both energy and timely wake-up pass; do not operate real facility power in this lesson.
Slurm can suspend and resume idle nodes; an energy ledger tests when sleeping is worthwhile.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「案例與來源邊界」。Slurm 可透過 suspend/resume 管理空閒節點；本課以能源帳本分析休眠何時值得。 與本階段判準一起判讀：量綱W×s=J，所有額外成本有唯一歸屬。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies case and source boundary. Slurm can suspend and resume idle nodes; an energy ledger tests when sleeping is worthwhile. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: W×s=J and every extra cost has one accounting location.

quiz.question: 「能源邊界圖」：若要檢查結果是否可信，哪一項提供本課的獨立驗證動作？
quiz.questionEn: Energy-boundary diagram: Which statement provides an independent verification action for judging whether the result is credible?
options: 損益平衡6000/110≈54.55 s；兩情境都高於它，但不保證滿足工作起點。
若節能卻增加工作遲到，查 resume timeout、啟動抖動與預留；失聯節點不能被視為已可排程。
合成 idle=120 W、sleep=10 W、轉換額外6000 J；可休眠30 min改5 min。
optionsEn: Break-even is 6000/110≈54.55 s; both exceed it but may still violate job-start needs.
Energy savings with late jobs require checking resume timeout, boot variability and reservations; unresponsive nodes are not schedulable.
Synthetic idle=120 W, sleep=10 W, transition cost=6000 J; eligible sleep changes from 30 to 5 min.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「獨立驗證方法」。損益平衡6000/110≈54.55 s；兩情境都高於它，但不保證滿足工作起點。 與本階段判準一起判讀：量綱W×s=J，所有額外成本有唯一歸屬。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies independent verification. Break-even is 6000/110≈54.55 s; both exceed it but may still violate job-start needs. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: W×s=J and every extra cost has one accounting location.

steps.title: 能源邊界圖 · 比較擾動與量測
steps.titleEn: Energy-boundary diagram · Compare perturbations and measurements
steps.objective: 完成「能源邊界圖」的比較擾動與量測，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete compare perturbations and measurements for Energy-boundary diagram and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
損益平衡6000/110≈54.55 s；兩情境都高於它，但不保證滿足工作起點。
回到本階段實驗：將 idle、sleep、transition 分三段，確認轉換成本不是再次包含在休眠秒數。
把名義組與變更組並列，逐欄確認只改了預定條件；若需多變量，另開實驗編號。用同一單位檢查趨勢、偏差與判準：量綱W×s=J，所有額外成本有唯一歸屬。
steps.instructionEn:
Break-even is 6000/110≈54.55 s; both exceed it but may still violate job-start needs.
Return to the investigation: Separate idle, sleep and transition segments and ensure transition cost is not double-counted.
Compare nominal and changed runs column by column, confirming that only intended conditions changed. Give multi-variable experiments separate IDs. Check trend, bias, and criterion in common units: W×s=J and every extra cost has one accounting location.
steps.observation: 對照組與變更組的差異能追到明確輸入或量測機制。損益平衡6000/110≈54.55 s；兩情境都高於它，但不保證滿足工作起點。
steps.observationEn: Differences between control and changed runs trace to explicit inputs or measurement mechanisms. Break-even is 6000/110≈54.55 s; both exceed it but may still violate job-start needs.
steps.failure: 同時變更多個輸入卻把結果歸因於單一因素。
steps.failureEn: Changing multiple inputs and attributing the output difference to a single factor.
steps.check: 量綱W×s=J，所有額外成本有唯一歸屬。
steps.checkEn: W×s=J and every extra cost has one accounting location.

quiz.question: 「能源邊界圖」：哪一項指出本課需保留的異常機制或替代解釋，不能直接當成驗收成功？
quiz.questionEn: Energy-boundary diagram: Which statement identifies an anomaly mechanism or competing explanation that cannot be treated as successful acceptance?
options: 名義式 (120-10)*30*60-6000 = 192000 J/node；變更式 (120-10)*5*60-6000 = 27000 J/node。把可真正休眠時段由30縮為5分鐘，轉換成本固定。 全部負載、量測和門檻是原創教學假設，不是產品規格。
交付能源分解、損益點、喚醒狀態機與預留時間表。
若節能卻增加工作遲到，查 resume timeout、啟動抖動與預留；失聯節點不能被視為已可排程。
optionsEn: Nominal: (120-10)*30*60-6000 = 192000 J/node; changed: (120-10)*5*60-6000 = 27000 J/node. Shorten actual eligible sleep from 30 to 5 minutes with fixed transition cost. All workload measurements and thresholds are original teaching assumptions, not product specifications.
Deliver energy breakdowns, break-even point, wake-state machines and reservation timing.
Energy savings with late jobs require checking resume timeout, boot variability and reservations; unresponsive nodes are not schedulable.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「故障與替代解釋」。若節能卻增加工作遲到，查 resume timeout、啟動抖動與預留；失聯節點不能被視為已可排程。 與本階段判準一起判讀：量綱W×s=J，所有額外成本有唯一歸屬。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies fault and competing explanation. Energy savings with late jobs require checking resume timeout, boot variability and reservations; unresponsive nodes are not schedulable. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: W×s=J and every extra cost has one accounting location.

steps.title: 能源邊界圖 · 分辨異常成因
steps.titleEn: Energy-boundary diagram · Discriminate anomaly causes
steps.objective: 完成「能源邊界圖」的分辨異常成因，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete discriminate anomaly causes for Energy-boundary diagram and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
若節能卻增加工作遲到，查 resume timeout、啟動抖動與預留；失聯節點不能被視為已可排程。
對照「能源邊界圖」的名義結果，分別建立系統故障與量測／紀錄偏移兩個解釋。指定一項能分辨它們的獨立觀察，再依證據選擇處置。同時通過能量與準時喚醒才接受；不要在本課操作真實機房電源。
本階段必須重驗：量綱W×s=J，所有額外成本有唯一歸屬。
steps.instructionEn:
Energy savings with late jobs require checking resume timeout, boot variability and reservations; unresponsive nodes are not schedulable.
Against the nominal Energy-boundary diagram result, build competing system-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. Accept only when both energy and timely wake-up pass; do not operate real facility power in this lesson.
Reverify this criterion: W×s=J and every extra cost has one accounting location.
steps.observation: 證據能區分兩個成因；不足時明列待測量，不把猜測當結案。若節能卻增加工作遲到，查 resume timeout、啟動抖動與預留；失聯節點不能被視為已可排程。
steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. Energy savings with late jobs require checking resume timeout, boot variability and reservations; unresponsive nodes are not schedulable.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.
steps.check: 量綱W×s=J，所有額外成本有唯一歸屬。
steps.checkEn: W×s=J and every extra cost has one accounting location.

steps.objective: 完成「能源邊界圖」的驗收並留下交接件，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for Energy-boundary diagram and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付能源分解、損益點、喚醒狀態機與預留時間表。
在交接件中加入「能源邊界圖」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：量綱W×s=J，所有額外成本有唯一歸屬。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：以合成資料重建「Slurm Power Save：休眠損益與喚醒延遲」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付能源分解、損益點、喚醒狀態機與預留時間表。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver energy breakdowns, break-even point, wake-state machines and reservation timing.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Energy-boundary diagram: W×s=J and every extra cost has one accounting location.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Reconstruct Slurm power saving: sleep break-even and wake latency with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver energy breakdowns, break-even point, wake-state machines and reservation timing. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。量綱W×s=J，所有額外成本有唯一歸屬。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. W×s=J and every extra cost has one accounting location.
steps.failure: 警報消失即宣稱通過，未按本階段判準重新驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.
steps.check: 量綱W×s=J，所有額外成本有唯一歸屬。
steps.checkEn: W×s=J and every extra cost has one accounting location.
